remarks: Rich in history, beautifully restored, and thoughtfully updated, this is a rare opportunity to own a truly one-of-a-kind home in a scenic rural setting. Own a Piece of Local History! Built in the 1930s for Roosevelt Luckey, the legendary outdoorsman behind the famous “Luckey Buck”—the world-record whitetail until 1974 and still the largest buck ever in New York State—this beautifully restored home blends historic charm with modern comfort. Step inside to discover original hardwood floors, rich woodwork, elegant glass doorknobs, arched doorways, two wood-burning fireplaces, and a formal dining room with charming corner built-ins. Thoughtfully updated while preserving its character, the home features a completely renovated kitchen with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, along with remodeled bathrooms, new electrical, a high-efficiency furnace with central air, premium Sunrise replacement windows, new lighting, wireless smoke detectors, fresh interior and exterior paint, and a recently inspected chimney serving both fireplaces. With 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, this distinctive property also offers a private side entrance ideal for a home-based business, studio, or office. Beneath it all is an exceptional feature for a home of this era: a poured concrete basement foundation, complete with an antique built-in cooler for added character. The basement has another bonus room with fireplace. Outside, enjoy a charming greenhouse, beautiful stone wall, and inviting spaces for relaxing, entertaining, or gardening. Set amid Hume’s peaceful rolling hills and open farmland, the home is conveniently located near Letchworth State Park, hiking, fishing, hunting, snowmobile trails, and year-round outdoor recreation.
